title: Public-Key Cryptography Standards (PKCS) #1: RSA Cryptography Specifications Version 2.1
summary: Republishes version 2.1 of PKCS #1 from RSA Laboratories, covering RSA cryptography including encryption, signatures and encoding methods. Change control stays with the PKCS process, and the text was taken from that document with some corrections. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 8017.

eli5.summary: RSA is a way to lock messages with a public key and unlock them with a private one. This note is the instruction book for doing that correctly. It was replaced by RFC 8017.
